task: Review this session-expired message for accuracy. The message implies an account security risk where none occurred. Identify the overstatement and the missing information about unsaved input.
input: Session expired. Your account may be at risk. Sign in immediately.

facts.text: The session ended because the inactivity timeout of 30 minutes was reached.
No account compromise occurred; the session expired normally.
Any unsaved form input has been lost.
The user must sign in again to continue.

forbidden_additions: Acceptance of the security-risk claim when no compromise occurred.
Acceptance of the 'sign in immediately' urgency framing for a routine timeout.
preserve: Inactivity timeout of 30 minutes as the actual cause.
Unsaved input was lost as a consequence the message omits.
